title: Positive Weighted Curvatures on Compact Manifolds with Weighted Convex Boundary and Proper Manifolds
summary: Given a Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$ equipped with a positive density function $f = e^{-\varphi}$, we study the weighted sectional curvature $\overline{\sec}_\varphi(U,V)$ and the $k$-th intermediate weighted Ricci curvature $\overline{\text{Ric}}_{k,\varphi}(U,V)$. We show that $\overline{\sec}_\varphi(U,V)$ and $\overline{\text{Ric}}_{k,\varphi}(U,V)$, together with the weighted second fundamental form $\widetilde{\mathrm{I\!I}}$, play central roles in controlling the topology of the manifold.
